teacher_preprocessing: same v631a full frame FP32 RGB, replicate bottom8, 2*x-1, fixed EMA Open-MAGVIT2 encoder continuous pre-LFQ

bootstrap.unit: dataset/video clusters; retain QPs and alphas

quant_boundary: normalized, conditional-mean-centered active nonsaturated residual at k+0.5; separately record scale skip boundary at .12 and saturation
entropy: actual integer CDF bin mass used by RANS for y; escape event counted, bypass escape bits unavailable; not full stream likelihood or per-channel real allocation
prediction: unavailable: context feature is not an explicit prediction of source RGB or analysis latent
quality_limit: alpha !=1 fixed B1 receiver is unadapted intervention; B1_alpha0 != Original or fair No-P
matched_rate: B1_alpha100 vs Original; per video common actual-bpp interval,100 uniform log-rate points,PCHIP,no extrapolation; video-weighted summary
rate_band: tertiles of alpha0 actual_bpp within dataset; fixed from control, shared across alpha

decision.A: stable coding change across datasets + consistent quantization changes + matched-rate >=2/3 perceptual improvements with bootstrap95 upper<0 + teacher worse/rate better in >=50% video/QP pairs
decision.B: actual rates change but A not met, including heterogeneous domains
decision.C: no measured systematic rate or coding-tensor change
decision.missing: Not_assessable; never classify incomplete data as C
